success.description: Funds successfully credited to the user's bank account.

failed / faled.description: Funds transfer rejected or failed (e.g. invalid account/IFSC, insufficient gateway balance). Note: 'faled' is a

pending.description: Payout is currently in transit at the bank.
pending.source: Initial payout request confirmation payload from the provider API.
pending.use: Locks the request to prevent duplicate payout API calls while waiting for the final bank status.

rejected.description: Payout blocked by the gateway's risk validation or fraud checks.
rejected.use: Requires manual compliance review by JGH admins.

kyc_status.name: kyc_status
kyc_status.business_value: Enforces tax compliance and identity verification.
kyc_status.trigger: (Trigger): Set by automated KYC validation engines (Aadhaar/PAN API) or manual

0 (Unverified).description: KYC process has not been completed or started.
0 (Unverified).source: Default status for newly created accounts.
0 (Unverified).use: Blocks the user from requesting cash withdrawals to comply with tax guidelines.

1 (Verified).description: User's Aadhaar and PAN documents verified as authentic.
1 (Verified).source: Digio verification callback or manual admin verification.
1 (Verified).use: Enables the cash withdrawal feature in the user's mobile wallet.

2 (Rejected).description: Aadhaar/PAN verification failed due to document mismatches.
2 (Rejected).use: Restricts withdrawals and flags the account for document correction.

status.name: status
status.description: User Account Access Status
status.business_value: Enforces platform security and KYC validation checks.
status.trigger: (Trigger): Set manually by Business/Super Admins on the dashboard panel.

pending.description: User profile is registered but has not been verified by an admin.
pending.source: Automatically assigned during user self-onboarding in the mobile app.
pending.use: Allows the user to log in but restricts them from scanning QR codes or withdrawing cash until approved.

approved.source: Dashboard action by a Super Admin after reviewing user documents.
approved.use: Unlocks full access to loyalty scans, target schemes, and points withdrawals.

rejected.description: User onboarding application failed validation (e.g. incorrect PAN, fake store name).
rejected.source: Dashboard rejection action by an Admin.
rejected.use: Suspends account features and prompts the user to re-upload clear profile information.

cash_point.description: QR Code Scan Reward: Retailer scanned a barcode box.
cash_point.use: Points credited to retailer wallet balance (linked to mypoints.id).

withdrawal.description: Cash Out Payout: User redeemed wallet points for bank account cash.
withdrawal.source: User submits withdrawal form in app.
withdrawal.use: Deducts cash amount from wallet balance (linked to withdrawal_request.id).

topup.description: Manual Adjustment: Admin manually adds/adjusts user points.

bonus_conversion.description: Cash-to-Bonus Conversion: Cash points converted into gift shop points.
bonus_conversion.source: User selects conversion in app profile.
bonus_conversion.use: Deducts cash balance and credits gift points (linked to bonus_transactions.id).

referral_earning.description: Referral Reward: Referrer earned points from a referred user.
referral_earning.use: Credits points to referrer wallet balance (reference_id is NULL).

credit_note.description: Credit Note Settlement: Payout adjusted directly with distributor.
credit_note.use: Deducts settled credit note value from wallet (linked to retailer_credit_notes.id).

incentive.description: Campaign Target Points: Awarded for hitting growth target schemes.
incentive.use: Credits campaign scheme bonus to wallet (linked to incentive_schemes.id).

status.name: status
status.description: Wallet Points Ledger Transaction Status
status.business_value: Represents the validation stage of the financial point entry.
status.trigger: (Trigger): Logged by database triggers on QR scan completes or payout requests.

0 (pending).description: Points entry initiated but awaiting system validation or admin approval.
0 (pending).use: Temporarily reserves the points, preventing balance inflation before verification completes.

1 (success).source: Successful QR validation webhook or approved payout.
1 (success).use: Increments or decrements the user's active wallet balance (wallet_balance) permanently.

2 (failed).source: QR validation rejection or payout request cancellation.
2 (failed).use: Invalidates the points transaction, preventing any balance changes.

status.name: status
status.description: Cash Withdrawal Workflow State
status.business_value: Controls the validation and release of cash payouts.
status.trigger: (Trigger): Initiated by the user and processed by dashboard administrators.

0 (pending).description: Withdrawal requested by the user and queued for accountant review.
0 (pending).source: User submits a payout form in the mobile wallet.
0 (pending).use: Appears on the dashboard payout queue for approval.

1 (approved).description: Withdrawal request authorized and bank transfer completed.
1 (approved).source: Accountant clicks 'Approve' on the dashboard, triggering the payout API.
1 (approved).use: Confirms the funds have been successfully routed to the bank.

2 (Reject).source: Dashboard rejection action by an Admin (e.g. incorrect bank account details).
2 (Reject).use: Reverses the points back to the user's active wallet balance and notifies them.
